fixes.what: Add `align-content:start` to `.journey__stop` so the Persian label and note sit directly under each English title; today the shorter stops stretch to the tallest (Proposal) and their Persian lines float at different heights (desktop-3: درخواست at y≈596, پیشنهاد at y≈548).
fixes.why: Five stops on one line read as one device only when their rows align; the drifting Persian breaks the rhythm.

fixes.what: Lighten the collapsed strips: drop brightness to .9 (not .75) and give collapsed panels a lighter overlay, e.g. `.accordion__panel:not(.is-open) .accordion__media::after{background:linear-gradient(to top,rgba(18,23,20,.8),rgba(18,23,20,.3))}`.
fixes.why: The five closed strips render as near-black slabs (desktop-2); the brand wants the row alive with image texture, not dead columns.

fixes.where: index.html pillars .card__n (01 · We are always / 02 · We always / 03 · We always)
fixes.what: Make the three eyebrows uniform numbers only (`01`, `02`, `03`) and let each h3 carry the full owner promise ("We are always fluent in the unspoken details" etc.).
fixes.why: The split eyebrows read as a typo ("WE ARE ALWAYS" beside "WE ALWAYS") and weaken the typographic system.

fixes.what: Remove the 52px left padding on the closing note; instead give `.form` 56px bottom padding on phones (the Pause button is fixed bottom-left, so the indent rarely lines up with it).
fixes.why: On phone-4 the note is indented 52px while every field above starts at the card edge: a visible ragged margin on the one conversion screen.

fixes.what: Move the phone leaf off the heading: `left:-40px;top:-24px` (or opacity .25) so it no longer sits behind the eyebrow “FIVE STEPS ON ONE LINE” (phone-3).
fixes.why: Decoration behind type reads as clutter, not framing; the tree art should stay at the edges.

fixes.where: site.css .field input,.field textarea,.field select (border:1px solid var(--stone))
fixes.what: Use the system weight: `border:2px solid rgba(185,179,166,.6)` (and 2px gold on focus) to match every other rule on the site.
fixes.why: The form inputs are the only 1px hairlines on the site and look thin next to the 2px gold rules and the 2px ghost tab.
